headline: Executive order directing federal agencies to support the reopening and continued operation of schools and early childhood education programs.
what_it_does: This executive order tells federal agencies to help schools and early childhood education providers reopen and keep operating. No summary was provided, so the specific actions, funding, or guidance it calls for are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: They are the main focus of federal efforts to support reopening and continued operation.

who_it_affects.group: Early childhood education providers, such as child care centers and preschools
who_it_affects.how: They are included in the federal efforts to support reopening and continued operation.
They may be affected by federal steps aimed at getting schools and early learning programs open and keeping them open.
